## Things I've Made

- [MEGU](https://github.com/RimunAce/megu): A Windows app for AniList with discovery, offline list sync, airing schedule and playback.

- [mcp-six-eyes](https://github.com/RimunAce/mcp-six-eyes): MCP server that gives text-only AI agents image understanding via vision APIs.
